text_block_list.text:

I got to watch your training session!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Not only is <chrname>'s running remarkable,
but your guidance as her trainer is truly something to behold.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Both your earnest posture and that forward-looking gazeâthey are precisely what belongs to one harboring romance in their heart!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... got a little too fired up there!
I'm expecting great things from you. Catch ya later!
